read2（）;君山烈狂傲无比的话让齐世龙也是微微有些恼怒，但此子身后代表着中州超级宗派，再加上他本身资质之绝世，修为之高深。
他说出的话，不得不让人掂量三分，显然没有料到事情会变成这番摸样，所有人的目光再度集中在了林无缺的身上。
在见识到君山烈的可怕之后，所有人都对这个狂傲的少年升起深深的惊惧，再联想到他的出身和所代表的势力，简直让人绝望！
中州的超级宗派啊！
那是比之东土百大主城还要强横的势力，是所有年轻人原本所向往的殿堂。这一刻，却被君山烈以这样霸道的方式烙印到慕容子弟们的内心当中。
“林无缺，十年后，他的性命，就掌握在你的手中。当然，如果你不愿与我一战，那么只要现在跪下说一句，放过我这个废物，我就给你和你的长青叔叔一条生路！”
说完这句话，君山烈不再言语，而是目光逼人的看着林无缺，他要看看这个让他耿耿于怀了十年的对手，会如何选择。
此话一出，所有人面色俱是一变！
跪下？求饶？
这是要林无缺放弃自己的尊严来换取活命的机会啊！
在林璎珞的眼神里，那个目光璀璨的少年在听完来自君山烈的逼迫之后，缓缓的低下了头，没人看得清那张俊秀的脸庞，不知道他心中在想些什么。
“这样的逼迫，你终究是扛不住了么？”
是啊！
君山烈，此人的可怕，根本不是现在的林无缺可以抗衡的，就算是十年后，也依旧如此，与其到时被君山烈像蝼蚁般捏死。还不如此刻低头求饶，最起码可以保住自己的性命。
这是所有慕容子弟心中的想法，在他们看来，与君山烈为敌，是这些慕容子弟想都不敢想的事。
慕容天此刻心中无比的畅快，虽然对于君山烈他同样不爽，但见得林无缺被君山烈逼迫到如此的绝境，慕容天感觉到自己身上的伤似乎都不那么痛了。
“无缺，好孩子，苦了你了……”
望着身旁这个少年缓缓低下的头，慕容长青忍不住一阵心痛。
这个孩子十年来，吃过多少苦，慕容长青都很了解，一路行来，无论多么的艰难，多么的不易，他始终没有放弃，始终执着着自己所选择的路。

如今，眼看他终于再度散发出耀眼的光芒，却又发生了这样的事，这一切，让慕容长青如何不痛心？

慕容长青觉得自己很没用，护不住这么一个才十五岁的少年，大手搭上了少年尚算稚嫩的肩膀，慕容长青心中做出了一个决定。
“无缺，十年的时间，对叔叔来说，也算不短了，你放心，叔叔就算是死，也会保住你的性命。只要你走，走的远远的，离开东土，那么天下之大，叔叔不信，会没有你的容身之处……”
大手用力的按着少年的肩膀，慕容长青声音快速而沉稳，回响在少年的耳边。
就在慕容长青再准备接着说下去时，他突然感觉到自己的手背上轻轻放上了一只修长白皙的手。
林无缺低下的脸庞轻轻的抬了起来，一双璀璨的目光此刻亮的惊人，心中却被一股浓浓的温暖所充斥，看着眼前一脸关切的慕容长青，林无缺淡淡一笑，轻声开口：“长青叔叔，一切都交给无缺吧。”
少年淡然的话语，让慕容长青一时有些无法分辨，他下意识的点点头。
“呼”
轻轻的呼出一口气，林无缺迈开了步子，欣长的身躯向着君山烈所在的下方走去。
“这种弱小的感觉，还真是讨厌呢。”

read2(); Jun Shanlie's extremely arrogant words made Qi Shilong slightly angry, but this man represents the super sect of Zhongzhou behind him, coupled with his own peerless qualifications and profound cultivation.
What he said had to be weighed carefully. Obviously, he did not expect that things would turn out like this. Everyone's eyes were once again focused on Lin Wuque.
After seeing the horror of Jun Shanlie, everyone was deeply frightened by this arrogant young man. When they think about his origin and the power he represents, it is simply despairing!
The super sect in Zhongzhou!
It was a force even more powerful than the hundred major cities in the East, and it was the palace that all young people originally aspired to. At this moment, Jun Shanlie branded it into the hearts of Murong's disciples in such a domineering way.
"Lin Wuque, ten years from now, his life will be in your hands. Of course, if you don't want to fight me, then just kneel down and say, let me go, and I will give you and your Uncle Chang Qing a way out!"
After saying this, Jun Shanlie stopped talking and looked at Lin Wuque with a compelling look. He wanted to see how the opponent he had been brooding about for ten years would choose.
As soon as these words came out, everyone's expressions changed!
Kneel down? beg for mercy?
This is asking Lin Wuque to give up his dignity in exchange for a chance to survive!
In Lin Yingluo's eyes, the young man with bright eyes slowly lowered his head after hearing the persecution from Jun Shanlie. No one could see clearly that handsome face, and they didn't know what he was thinking in his heart.
"Can you finally bear this kind of pressure?"
Yes!
Jun Shanlie, this person is so terrifying that Lin Wuque cannot compete with him now. Even ten years later, he will still be the same, rather than being crushed to death by Jun Shanlie like an ant. It's better to lower your head and beg for mercy now, at least you can save your life.
This is the thought in the hearts of all Murong disciples. In their view, becoming an enemy of Jun Shanlie is something that these Murong disciples dare not even think about.
Murong Tian felt extremely happy at this moment. Although he was also unhappy with Jun Shan Lie, seeing Lin Wuque being forced into such a desperate situation by Jun Shan Lie, Murong Tian felt that the injuries on his body seemed to be less painful.
"Wu Que, good boy, I've suffered so much for you..."
Looking at the young man beside him who lowered his head slowly, Murong Changqing couldn't help but feel heartache.
Murong Changqing knew very well how much hardship this child had endured in the past ten years. No matter how difficult or difficult the journey was, he never gave up and always persisted in the path he had chosen.
Now, seeing him finally radiating dazzling light again, something like this happened again. How could Murong Changqing not be saddened by all this?

Murong Changqing felt that he was useless and could not protect such a fifteen-year-old boy, so he put his big hand on the boy's still immature shoulder, and Murong Changqing made a decision in his heart.
"Wu Que, ten years is not a short period of time for uncle. Don't worry, uncle will save your life even if he dies. As long as you go, go far away from the East, the world is so big, I don't believe it, there will be no place for you..."
His big hands pressed the young man's shoulders hard, and Murong Changqing's voice was fast and steady, echoing in the young man's ears.
Just when Murong Changqing was about to continue speaking, he suddenly felt a slender white hand gently placed on the back of his hand.
Lin Wuque's lowered face lifted slightly, his dazzling eyes were astonishingly bright at the moment, but his heart was filled with a strong warmth. Looking at Murong Changqing, who looked concerned in front of him, Lin Wuque smiled faintly and said softly: "Uncle Changqing, leave everything to Wuque."
The young man's indifferent words made Murong Changqing a little confused for a moment.Yes, he nodded subconsciously.
"Hoo"
With a gentle breath, Lin Wuque took steps, his long body walking towards the bottom where Jun Shanlie was.
"This feeling of weakness is really annoying."
